title: RepairTask
description: A bounded repair task produced by 08_repair_planner. Scope is strictly limited to fixing identified failures.

failure_rule_ids.description: IDs of validation rules that triggered this repair.

repair_artifacts.description: Artifact paths that this repair task may modify. Must be a subset of the parent task's allowed_write_paths.

max_attempts.description: Hard cap. Exceeding this routes to HUMAN_REVIEW.

repair_scope.description: One-sentence description of what the repair is allowed to change.

forbidden_scope_expansions.description: Actions this repair must never take, even if they would fix the failure.

new_paths_allowed.description: Whether the repair may write to paths not in the parent task. Default false.

new_commands_allowed.description: Whether the repair may run commands not in the parent task. Default false.
